score: ascending-dimension RN-FP64 squared L2, separate multiply/add; no FMA/reassociation; inherited original score cache
stage: offline exact-safe geometry diagnosis; not a novelty or latency claim
center: sort region object IDs ascending; RN-FP64 left fold per coordinate; divide by size; store RN FP32
ball: radius: full upper norm of abs(cached_z - stored_center)+ETA; FP32 upward; query lower norm minus stored_radius minus sqrt(8)*ETA upward minus RHO downward

minimax.update: at iteration t=1..64, c=c+(farthest_point-c)/(t+1), separate ops
minimax.farthest: RN-FP64 ordered 8-dimensional squared L2; ties smallest object ID
minimax.selection: smallest full maximum RN squared radius among initial center and 64 iterates; equal radius keeps earliest
minimax.quality: approximate center only; no optimizer optimality guarantee; witnessed cached RN half-diameter is only a numerical proxy, not a certified optimal-radius lower bound

ellipsoid.scale: FP32 upward max(abs(cached_z - stored_FP32_centroid)+ETA); positive also for zero spread
ellipsoid.factor: full upper norm of worst abs deviation/ stored scale; FP32 upward
ellipsoid.bound: nonnegative Lagrange dual: sum_j lambda*d_j^2/(scale_j^2+lambda) - lambda*R^2, downward, then sqrt downward and query ETA/RHO subtraction
ellipsoid.lambda: inside =>0; outside =>64 fixed bisections between 0 and sqrt(sum((scale*d)^2))/R; all coordinates ordered; optimizer need not be exact for safety

G5.selection: 16 uniform without-replacement region IDs per query per level; default_rng(20261012); level then query then sorted region order; selected before outcomes
G5.independent: original vectors: ordered projection and original score; independent centroid/minimax/scales/radii and scalar dual bound; all region objects; no tolerance for metadata/truth equality

auxiliary_projected_oracle: diagnostic only, no new certificate/metadata: each query-region minimum projected point distance interval; upper bound limits every enclosing shape with same fixed projection; never used as deployable bound

gates.strong: same L3/L4 hard>=3/5, all>=3/5, worst>=1/4, aligned<=64
gates.signal: same L3/L4 hard>=9/20, hard gain>=3/20, worst-hard-min alignment gain>=1/10; geometry-only allowed80B, annotate over64B; not matched-budget admission
gates.K1: every new shape across BOTH L3/L4 has hard gain<1/20
gates.K2: only >128B shapes yield hard gain>=3/20; structurally unreachable in frozen48/80B matrix
gates.K3: one shape L5 hard gain>=3/20 and both its L3/L4 hard gains<1/20
gates.arithmetic: exact Fraction count ratios; no rounded threshold input

resources.placement: one CPU core, memory local to its NUMA node; private invocation retains actual core/node IDs

figure_selection: all four shapes all three levels; hard query rescue L4 all six hard queries; dead gap CDF hard6 L4 unweighted query-region pairs; byte scatter all12cells
